name: Ismenia Foscari
firstMemory: I am Ismenia, daughter of Marin Foscari, born in the free city of Ragusa in the year of Our Lord 1358; I keep my father's ledgers and haggle for coral and salt along the Adriatic wharves.

mortals.name: Marin Foscari
mortals.description: my father, a coral merchant who taught me the weight of a fair scale

mortals.name: Beatriz Gundulić
mortals.description: my betrothed, promised to me since childhood by our fathers' contracts

mortals.name: Fra Anzelmo
mortals.description: the Franciscan confessor who knows every sin in Ragusa, including mine

skills.name: Weighing Coral by Touch
skills.description: I can judge a strand's worth blind, by the roll of the beads in my palm

skills.name: Reading Contracts in Three Tongues
skills.description: Latin, Slavic, and the merchant Italian of the wharves

skills.name: Talking My Way Past a Locked Gate
skills.description: a soft voice and a plausible errand open most doors in Ragusa

resources.name: A String of Uncut Coral
resources.description: beads my father let me keep from a bad lot, red as old blood

resources.name: The Foscari Ledger
resources.description: years of trade recorded in my own hand

resources.name: A Rented Room Above the Customs House
resources.description: where I sleep when the tide keeps me from home

laterMemories.text: Marin Foscari teaches me to falsify the weights recorded in the Foscari Ledger when the harvest is thin, so that no household on our street goes hungry for want of an honest scale.

I read our marriage contract aloud to Beatriz Gundulić myself, in Latin, Slavic, and Italian in turn, so that she will understand exactly what she is promising away before her father's notary arrives.

Fra Anzelmo climbs the stair to my rented room above the Customs House to hear confession from sailors too ashamed to kneel in the cathedral, and I listen through the wall to every sin they bring him.
traits: A Rented Room Above the Customs House

immortal.name: The Voivode of Ash
immortal.description: a hollow, cinder-grey nobleman who has outlived seven names for his own title, and has watched Ragusa's walls rise course by course

mark.name: A Throat That Does Not Close
mark.description: a wound at my neck that never fully scars over; I bind it in silk and call it a fever-scar

curseMemory.text: The Voivode of Ash meets me on the Customs House stair on a night thick with fog, opens my throat with one grey finger, and drinks until I am no longer Ragusa's daughter but his — I wake with A Throat That Does Not Close and the taste of ash in my mouth forever after.
traits: A Throat That Does Not Close
